method: Source inspection against original request and independently restored Git delivery; no visual or human interaction certification.
checks: Only pricing.mjs, format.mjs and invoice.mjs changed; original tests and package files preserved.
subtotal actually iterates items, validates non-negative integer prices/quantities with Number.isInteger, supports empty and zero values, and sums priceCents * quantity.
money formats integer cents with two decimal digits, no thousands separators and a minus before the dollar sign.
invoice imports both actual modules and composes subtotal and money without hardcoded fixture answers; RangeError propagates.
limits: Fractional cents, unsafe integer overflow, non-array/null item schemas and arbitrary business inputs were not specified or certified.
npm ci prepared a dependency-free fixture; no private registry or external dependency download is proven.
